# Flare HTM Structure Validation Skill

## Overview
This skill provides a structured validation checklist for Flare HTM output generated by the Draft-doc agent. Use this to catch common structural issues early, before content enters review or publication workflows.

## When to Use
- After drafting Flare HTM content fragments (procedural steps, API tables, release notes, etc.)
- Before committing Flare topic files to the repository
- When reviewing generated markup for consistency with existing topic patterns
- To validate that generated elements will render correctly in Flare output

## Validation Checklist

### 1. Tag Integrity
- [ ] All opening tags have matching closing tags (e.g., `<p>...</p>`, `<div>...</div>`)
- [ ] No orphaned tags (e.g., `<p>` without `</p>`, `<li>` without `</li>`)
- [ ] Self-closing tags use correct syntax: `<br />`, `<img ... />` (XML/XHTML style)
- [ ] No extra closing tags or duplicate tag pairs
- [ ] Tagnames use correct casing (lowercase for HTML: `<p>`, `<li>`, `<span>`)

### 2. Nesting and Hierarchy
- [ ] All nested elements are properly closed before their parent closes (no "crossing" tags)
  - ✗ Bad: `<div><p></div></p>`
  - ✓ Good: `<div><p></p></div>`
- [ ] Heading levels do not skip (e.g., no `<h2>` followed directly by `<h4>` without `<h3>`)
- [ ] `<table>` contains `<thead>` and/or `<tbody>`, and rows/cells are nested correctly
- [ ] `<ul>` and `<ol>` contain only `<li>` elements (no direct text or other elements)
- [ ] Block-level elements (`<div>`, `<p>`, `<ul>`) are not nested inside inline elements (`<span>`, `<code>`, `<strong>`)

### 3. List and Procedure Validation
- [ ] Single-step procedures use `<p>` or single-item `<ul>`, not `<ol>`
- [ ] Multi-step procedures use `<ol>` with sequential `<li>` items
- [ ] Each `<ol>`/`<ul>` has at least one `<li>` child
- [ ] No empty list items (e.g., `<li></li>`)

### 4. Code Blocks and Inline Code
- [ ] Inline code uses `<code>...</code>` blocks, not backticks (unless rendering code fence)
- [ ] Code blocks use `<pre><code>...</code></pre>` structure
- [ ] `<pre>` and `<code>` are properly closed
- [ ] Special characters inside code are properly escaped (see Section 8 for reference)

### 5. Table Structure
- [ ] `<table>` always has `<thead>` and/or `<tbody>` sections
- [ ] All `<tr>` elements are inside `<thead>`, `<tbody>`, or `<tfoot>`
- [ ] Header rows use `<th>` elements, not `<td>`
- [ ] All `<th>` and `<td>` are inside `<tr>` elements
- [ ] Table rows have consistent column counts (no misaligned columns)
- [ ] No empty table cells unless intentional; consider adding `&nbsp;` only if rendering requires content

### 6. Semantic Markup
- [ ] Navigation menus use `<span class="ui_item">Item</span> > <span class="ui_item">SubItem</span>` (not backticks)
- [ ] Notes/warnings/tips use correct `<div>` class: `<div class="Note">`, `<div class="Tip">`, `<div class="Warning">`
- [ ] Prerequisites use `<p>Prerequisites:</p>` followed by `<ul>`
- [ ] Images include `alt` attributes
- [ ] Links use descriptive text, not "click here" patterns

### 7. Attributes and Declarations
- [ ] All attribute values are enclosed in quotes (e.g., `href="path/to/file"`, not `href=path/to/file`)
- [ ] Class attributes match Flare/Qlik conventions (no invented class names unless approved)
- [ ] DOCTYPE or namespace declarations are consistent with existing topic files (if applicable)

### 8. Character Encoding and Special Characters
- [ ] Special HTML characters are properly escaped:
  - `&lt;` for `<`
  - `&gt;` for `>`
  - `&amp;` for `&`
  - `&quot;` for `"` (in attributes)
  - `&nbsp;` for non-breaking space (use sparingly)
- [ ] No raw `<` or `>` characters inside text (except in code blocks with proper escaping)
- [ ] Dashes use correct entities: `&ndash;` (en-dash) or `&mdash;` (em-dash) where semantically appropriate

### 9. Flare-Specific Elements
- [ ] MadCap namespace prefixes (if used) are consistent throughout the fragment
- [ ] Conditional attributes or markers align with Flare build targets (if applicable)

## Quick Reference: Common Flare Patterns

### Procedure
```html
<p>Do the following:</p>
<ol>
  <li>Click <span class="ui_item">File</span>.</li>
  <li>Select <span class="ui_item">New</span>.</li>
  <li>Click <span class="ui_item">OK</span>.</li>
</ol>
```

### Note/Tip/Warning
```html
<div class="Note">
  <p>Note: This is important information.</p>
</div>

<div class="Tip">
  <p>Tip: Consider this best practice.</p>
</div>

<div class="Warning">
  <p>Warning: This action has consequences.</p>
</div>
```

### API Parameter Table
```html
<table class="ParamTable">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Parameter</th>
      <th>Type</th>
      <th>Required</th>
      <th>Description</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>id</td>
      <td>string</td>
      <td>Yes</td>
      <td>Unique identifier of the resource.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>limit</td>
      <td>integer</td>
      <td>No</td>
      <td>Maximum number of records to return.</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

### Inline Code + Navigation
```html
<p>In the left pane, click <span class="ui_item">Settings</span> > <span class="ui_item">Connection</span>. Enter the connection details in the <code>hostname</code> field.</p>
```

## Troubleshooting Invalid Output

When validation fails, cross-reference the symptom to the checklist section:

| Symptom | Checklist Section |
|---------|-------------------|
| Unclosed tags, orphaned tags, tag case issues | Section 1: Tag Integrity |
| Nesting/hierarchy errors, crossing tags | Section 2: Nesting and Hierarchy |
| List structure or empty items | Section 3: List and Procedure Validation |
| Code block/inline code issues | Section 4: Code Blocks and Inline Code |
| Table structure or misaligned cells | Section 5: Table Structure |
| Special character or escaping issues | Section 8: Character Encoding and Special Characters |
